sections.html: Usually no one expects predatory tetras to be especially colourful. There were doubts about the supplier's claim that Charax stenopterus, imported for the first time from Paraguay, were very nicely coloured when collected. But after some time of settling in, the fish really did become colourful, so the common name "Rainbow robber tetra" fits the fish well.
